text: Press the [BLUE]%action%[BLACK] to interact.
Use it to interact with characters, chests, or doors.
The clock to the right shows the current time.
When the clock reaches 19:30, the day ends.
The time flashes [FIREBRICK]red[BLACK] when it's almost night.
Press the [BLUE]%inventory%[BLACK] to access your inventory,
where you can view your equipment, attributes, skills, and more.
Approaching an enemy triggers a battle.
Victory in battles rewards you with [FOREST]XP[BLACK],
which can be used to improve your character.
Battle Tutorial (1/7)
The battlefield consists of the two rows you can see below.
The lower row for your party, the upper for the enemies.
The [FIREBRICK]red[BLACK] spaces on the upper row indicate your attack range.
Each turn, you get a certain amount of Action Points (AP).
With these AP, you can move, attack, or do other actions.
Battle Tutorial (2/7)
Each enemy has an [BLUE]advantage[BLACK] ([BLUE]+[BLACK]) and a
[FIREBRICK]disadvantage[BLACK] ([FIREBRICK]-[BLACK]) to certain weapon types.
Try to use the [BLUE]right weapon type[BLACK]
against the enemy's disadvantage.
[FIREBRICK]BEWARE![BLACK] When having a disadvantage against an enemy,
means that the enemy has an advantage against you!
Battle Tutorial (3/7)
At the start of each turn, if a character begins
next to an enemy, they become locked in battle.
This is marked by a small exclamation mark [!].
This [BLUE]significantly[BLACK] increases the AP cost to move
away from that enemy and escape the battle lock.
Battle Tutorial (4/7)
When you end your turn, if there is any AP left,
up to [BLUE]2 AP[BLACK] will be added to your next turn's AP.
For now, with your current attributes,
it means you can have a maximum of 6 AP.
Battle Tutorial (5/7)
At the top of the screen, you can see the turn order.
The character highlighted in [GOLDENROD]yellow[BLACK] will act first.
The turn order is based on the [BLUE]Speed[BLACK] attribute.
Higher speed means acting earlier in the round.
The speed of your party members is displayed.
The enemy's speed is unknown and shown as a
question mark. However, you can estimate it by
comparing the turn order with your party's speed.
Battle Tutorial (6/7)
Weapons and shields have limited [BLUE]durability[BLACK].
You can see their durability in parentheses after
the item's name. Each use reduces durability by 1.
When durability reaches [FIREBRICK]0[BLACK], the item breaks and is lost.
Always monitor your weapon's durability to avoid surprises!
Battle Tutorial (7/7)
It is possible that you have acquired a magic spell by now.
If so, you can use it in the battle menu under [BLUE]Special[BLACK].
Remember, magic spells require resources to cast.
Press the [BLUE]%logbook%[BLACK] to access your logbook.
Here, you can find all quest-related information.
A main quest is marked with an [M].
Press the [BLUE]%minimap%[BLACK] in large areas to view an overview of that area.
This helps prevent getting lost, especially in dark caves.
(Note: Small areas do not offer this overview option.)
If you missed any of these messages or want to review them,
press the [BLUE]%manual%[BLACK] to see the history of these messages.
Press the [BLUE]%inventory%[BLACK] to access your inventory.
Here, you can equip various items such as armor and weapons.
These items will help you in battles and other situations.
During conversations with other characters,
you have the opportunity to choose your responses.
But certain responses are [BLUE]restricted[BLACK] by specific
conditions. These conditions are stated between
brackets [ ] in front of the response.
With the [BLUE]%slow%[BLACK] you can toggle to move stealthily.
Enemies will have a harder time detecting you,
enabling you to avoid battles if necessary.
The bottom right corner shows whether you're crouching.
Weapons require a minimum rank of Intelligence, Dexterity, or
Strength. Check the weapon's description for that requirement.
If you meet the requirement, you can equip the weapon.
Access your attributes by pressing the [BLUE]%inventory%[BLACK].
Use [FOREST]XP[BLACK] to level them up with the [BLUE]%action%[BLACK].
A [PURPLE]purple arrow[BLACK] indicates your [FOREST]XP[BLACK] is sufficient.
You have learned a magic spell.
Press the [BLUE]%inventory%[BLACK] to view your spells.
New spells are added to your 'Spells/ Abilities' list.
With the [BLUE]%fast%[BLACK] you can toggle to run.
You'll move faster, but enemies will detect you more easily.
The bottom right corner shows whether you're running.
Remember to press the [BLUE]%logbook%[BLACK] to access your logbook.
Here, you can find all quest-related information,
like finding secret doors.
Also remember to press the [BLUE]%minimap%[BLACK] to view the area overview.
The closet behind you can be used for storage.
When your inventory becomes full, store items in your closet.
They will be [BLUE]safe[BLACK] and kept there until you need them.
Perhaps some of your belongings are already stored there?
People may share [BLUE]different[BLACK] information at different times.
Keep this in mind!
The village elder is a good example of this behavior.
One of your main quests was failed.
Press the [BLUE]%logbook%[BLACK] to access your logbook.
A red [FIREBRICK]X[BLACK] indicates a failed quest.
In this specific case, just follow the other main quest.
Luana has joined your party.
Press the [BLUE]%inventory%[BLACK] to view her equipment, attributes and skills.
Luana is a Thief and a Mechanic. Check her skills to see what she can do.
If a party member dies, they cannot be revived, they are gone forever.
